findings.description: The KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation = true. Without automatic key rotation, the same key material is used indefinitely, increasing the risk associated with key compromise over time.

findings.issue_category: missing key policy / overly permissive default
findings.description: No policy is defined for the KMS key, so AWS applies the default key policy which grants the entire AWS account (all IAM principals with appropriate IAM permissions) full access to the key via 'kms:*'. This violates least privilege for a key protecting audit trail data, as any IAM principal with broad IAM permissions could gain use/management access to the key.
